note: Documentary target, not implemented. All snapshots and values are synthetic; source identifies the required BCCh series/statistic but fixture_only prevents interpreting these as fetched quotations. Current runner requires later adaptation. Ten scenarios plus attached complete-input variants. Recursive partial expectations; repeat_of/same_result_as assert full pure-result equality. expect_financial_scope asserts common normalization; expect_integration asserts control flow, not new API fields. Infrastructure fallback is resolved before the pure call. Dates/amounts are audit/branch probes, never defaults.
